instruction: Configure a DNS server with BIND
Configure a caching DNS resolver with unbound
output: apt install -y unbound && echo -e 'server:\n  interface: 0.0.0.0\n  access-control: 192.168.1.0/24 allow' > /etc/unbound/unbound.conf && systemctl restart unbound

instruction: Configure a DNS stub resolver with dnsmasq
output:
apt install -y dnsmasq && echo -e 'server=8.8.8.8
server=1.1.1.1
domain-needed
bogus-priv' > /etc/dnsmasq.conf && systemctl restart dnsmasq

instruction: Configure a mail server with Postfix (satellite)
output: apt install -y postfix && postconf -e "relayhost = smtp.example.com" && postconf -e "mydestination =" && systemctl restart postfix

instruction: Configure a mail server with Postfix (local delivery)
output: postconf -e "mydestination = mail.example.com, localhost" && postconf -e "myhostname = mail.example.com" && systemctl restart postfix
